status: comparison_only - the canonical ToN contract is results/ton_iot_current.json
question: Edge injection revives the feedback mechanism on UNSW (churn 0.0000 -> 0.0251). Does it transfer to ToN-IoT?
verdict: NO. Churn stays ~0.001 and the ladder is unchanged. ToN's mechanism fails for a DIFFERENT structural reason than UNSW's, and edge injection does not address it.

root_cause_in_degree.note: Attention re-weighting is a softmax over a node's incoming edges. On a node with in-degree 1 that softmax is 1.0 no matter what bias is added, so the mechanism is a mathematical no-op there.
root_cause_in_degree.reading: 62.8% of ToN edges point at a node with a single incoming edge. Attention has nothing to weigh on the majority of the graph.

co_location.note: Co-located edges share a (src,dst) pair, so the four node-derived terms of the edge representation are identical and only edge_attr separates them. This is the failure edge injection fixes.
co_location.reading: ToN barely has the co-location problem, which is why edge injection buys almost nothing there. The two datasets fail for different reasons: UNSW's attention works but cannot separate co-located edges; ToN's attention is inert for lack of neighbours.

injection_scale_selection.protocol: validation folds only, seed 42, fusion on, top_k=23.0

ladder_fusion_on.reading: AGAF remains the top ToN rung under both injection modes. Edge injection moves the loop by +0.0063, inside the +/-0.02 seed spread, and churn stays ~0.001.

expanded_graph_assessment.artifact: data/ton_iot/processed/step1/pyg_data_expanded.pt (built 2026-07-19; its builder was deleted in c004ff6 as off-architecture)
expanded_graph_assessment.would_it_help: Structurally yes - it lifts mean in-degree 1.44 -> 18.3 and drops in-degree-1 edges 62.8% -> 4.7%, which is exactly what the mechanism needs, and it rebalances the rare classes (dos 4 -> 2954 sub-edges).

why_it_is_not_used.leakage: The archived folds are NOT group-aware. 93% of test edges in EVERY fold have a sibling sub-edge from the same (src,dst,attack) triple sitting in train; 256 of 356 multi-chunk triples straddle the split. Sub-edges of a triple share endpoints, label and near-identical attributes, so a model can memorise a triple in training and recall it at test. Any result from these folds is inflated.
why_it_is_not_used.information_ceiling: Even with group-aware folds the effective sample size stays 2127 triples, not 27070 edges. Chunking buys graph SHAPE, not information, and the rare classes stay rare in triple terms (dos 4 triples, ransomware 3).
why_it_is_not_used.architecture: The expanded graph carries 12 node features against the canonical 10, and its builder was removed as off-architecture, so it breaks the cross-dataset parity contract on two counts.

expanded_graph_assessment.verdict: Not adopted. Fixing the folds is necessary but not sufficient - it cannot fix ToN's class scarcity.

limitations: Single injection-scale grid (5/10/20) selected on validation at seed 42 only.
top_k was NOT re-selected for ToN under edge injection; 23.0 was carried from the canonical sweep.
The ToN ladder does not hold under either injection mode, unchanged from results/ton_iot_current.json.
